*Exodus advances consumer and enterprise payments strategy.*


*Third Quarter 2026 Revenue of $32.5 million.*


OMAHA, Neb., Nov. 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- **Exodus Movement, Inc.** (NYSE American: EXOD) ("Exodus"), a leading self-custodial finance and payments platform, today announced its unaudited results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.


"This quarter, we made substantial progress bringing Exodus, Monavate and Baanx together, combining our teams and simplifying how we operate," said JP Richardson, CEO of Exodus. "We are building toward a financial system where anyone can receive money, invest it and spend it as easily as they send a message, while retaining control of their assets. Exodus started by giving people control over their crypto. Through Exodus Wallet and XO Suite, the enterprise platform we are building, we are extending that foundation into everyday financial activity, both in our own app and other companies' products. As AI agents begin to transact on behalf of people and businesses, they will need that same infrastructure, with clear permissions and spending limits. Our goal is to make Exodus a foundation for how people, businesses, and their agents use money."

**Monavate Integration Update**


As a product of the Company's cost savings initiatives and capitalizing on synergies from the acquisition of Monavate Holdings Limited, Monavate Ltd., Baanx.com Ltd, and Baanx US Corp., Exodus is on track to reduce combined annual costs by approximately $30 million going into 2027. These cost reductions enhance Exodus' operating leverage and provide greater financial flexibility to reinvest in strategic growth initiatives, including product innovation and expansion into new markets.


**Third Quarter Operational and Other Financial Highlights**


- **Monthly Active Users ("MAUs"):** 1.4 million MAUs at the end of Q3 2026, unchanged from 1.4 million as of Q2 2026.
- **Quarterly Funded Users ("QFUs"):** 1.4 million QFUs at the end of Q3 2026, up 7.7% from 1.3 million as of Q2 2026.
- **Total Swap Volume:** $1.1 billion in total swap volume for Q3 2026, down 3.4% from Q2 2026.
- **Total Active Cards:** 1.6 million active cards during Q3 2026.
- **Gross Transaction Volume:** $1.1 billion processed in Q3 2026.
- **(Loss) Net Income Attributable to Exodus Movement, Inc.:** For the three months ended September 30, 2026, net loss was $8.3 million while the same period last year was net income of $17.0 million.
- **Adjusted EBITDA:** For the three months ended September 30, 2026, Adjusted EBITDA was a loss of $3.9 million while the same period last year was positive Adjusted EBITDA of $5.9 million.

**Non-GAAP Measures**


The unaudited adjusted results should not be construed as an alternative to the reported results determined in accordance with GAAP. These financial measures are not based on any standardized methodology and are not necessarily comparable to similar measures presented by other companies. The Company believes that these non-GAAP financial measures provide useful information to both management and investors to increase comparability to prior periods by adjusting for certain items that may not be indicative of core operating measures and to better identify trends in our business. The adjusted financial results are used by management to, and allow investors to, evaluate the operating performance of the Company compared to prior periods, when reviewed in conjunction with the Company's GAAP statements. These amounts are not determined in accordance with GAAP and therefore should not be used exclusively in evaluating the Company's business and operations.

**About Exodus**


Founded in 2015, Exodus Movement, Inc. (NYSE American: EXOD) is pioneering self-custodial finance by giving people the tools to earn rewards, spend, manage, and swap digital assets across borders, all without giving up control. Exodus serves millions of users through its products built on a simple principle: your money should be yours. Exodus also powers crypto infrastructure and card/payment services for enterprise platforms serving millions of users through its enterprise product suite. Headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska, Exodus is financial software where ownership is the default. For more information, visit exodus.com.
